fields.summary: The district hires Terraphase Engineering, Inc. for California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) consulting, including a preliminary findings memorandum, for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy modernization project. The $48,032 price includes a $4,313 contingency fee. Work starts October 10, 2024 and runs through September 26, 2025; the agenda text misprints the end year as 2024.

24-2283.sourceIssue: The text says work starts October 10, 2024 and lasts until September 26, 2024, an end date before the start date; the attached agreement gives an end date of September 26, 2025.
